2609.28029.title: Tensor Decomposition of Transformer Key-Value Caches: Spectral Structure and Format Comparison
2609.28029.paper_summary: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers can be viewed as a fourth-order tensor spanning attention heads, tokens, features, and grouped layers. We measure the singular-value spectra of all four mode unfoldings on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and LLaMA-2-13B and compare four standard tensor decompositions: Tucker, CP, tensor train, and t-SVD, at matched storage. The spectra partition the four axes into two classes. The token and feature modes carry low-rank structure, particularly for keys. The head and layer modes are nearly full-rank and resist compression at any practical error level. Among the four decompositions, Tucker achieves the lowest reconstruction error at every compression ratio from $2\times$ to $5\times$, because it can leave the full-rank modes untouched. Comparisons with two-dimensional unfolding baselines show that the preferred representation differs between keys and values: 2D methods achieve lower key error, while four-way Tucker achieves lower value error at matched storage. A mode-pinning theorem certifies the full-rank preservation from the measured spectra alone. Two further spectral properties affect the compressible modes without touching the full-rank ones: values reach a higher error floor than keys at every ratio, and post-RoPE keys lose $41\%$ - $64\%$ of their pre-RoPE compressibility on both models.
2609.28029.paper_summary_zh: 自回归Transformer的鍵值（KV）快取可以被視為一個跨越注意力頭、標記、特徵和分組層的四階張量。我們在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 LLaMA-2-13B 上測量所有四個模式展開的奇異值光譜，並比較四種標準的張量分解：Tucker、CP、張量列車和 t-SVD，並保持存儲匹配。這些光譜將四個軸分為兩類。標記和特徵模式承載低秩結構，特別是對於鍵。頭和層模式幾乎是滿秩的，並在任何實際誤差水平下抵抗壓縮。在這四種分解中，Tucker 在每個壓縮比從 $2\times$ 到 $5\times$ 時達到最低的重建誤差，因為它可以不觸碰滿秩模式。與二維展開基線的比較顯示，鍵和值之間的首選表示不同：2D 方法在鍵的誤差上達到較低，而四維 Tucker 在存儲匹配時在值的誤差上達到較低。一個模式固定定理證明了僅從測量的光譜中保留滿秩的可行性。兩個進一步的光譜特性影響可壓縮模式而不觸及滿秩模式：在每個比率下，值的誤差底線高於鍵，並且後 RoPE 鍵在兩個模型上失去了 $41\%$ - $64\%$ 的前 RoPE 可壓縮性。
